title: shadPS4 0.14.0: official stable release
summary: shadPS4 published 0.14.0 on February 7, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.14.0 on February 7, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official release description states: Greeting fellow users , testers , devs. Here is a brand new release from shadPS4 , It took as some time but some nice features are here so we wanted to share them with all of you out there . This new release brings some more compatiblity with games and several bug fixes.
